title: Midterm Room Change
transcript: Attention, students in Economics 101. Thursday's midterm will not be held in our usual classroom. Because of the class size, we'll be splitting into two rooms. If your last name begins with A through L, go to Room 140 in Baker Hall. M through Z, stay here in Room 305. Please bring your student ID, since we'll be checking it at the door. Calculators are allowed, but phones are not.

questions.stem: Why will the midterm be held in two rooms?
options: The usual classroom is being repaired
The class is too large for one room
The exam has two different versions
questions.explanation: The speaker says the class will split into two rooms because of the class size.

questions.stem: What are students asked to bring to the exam?
questions.explanation: Student IDs will be checked at the door.
